items.name: Cucugar's Ore-Bitten Pick
items.lore: The lurikeen who sold the Coruscating Mine to the siog swung this pick for thirty years. Sparks still leap from its head.

items.name: Fearan's Chitin Bracer
items.lore: A ring of shed carapace, hard as river stone.

items.name: Glare-Stone
items.lore: It still burns with the light that gave Glare its name. Casters of every school prize it.

items.name: Sloithi's Cutpurse Dirk
items.lore: The siog footpad captain's dirk, notched once for every purse cut on the Druim Cain road.

items.name: Rylie's Vigil Cloak
items.lore: Woven by the empyreans who keep watch by the menhir at the lake's southern shore.

items.name: Wilde's Mane Belt
items.lore: Braided from the mane of the wildest of the faerie steeds that run the southern meadows.

items.name: Tric's Trickster Ring
items.lore: Turn it on your finger and it is never quite where you left it.

items.name: Rasa's Lantern Jewel
items.lore: The keeper of the north-eastern glade carried this light through the longest nights of the sidhe.

items.name: Erhael's Waylaying Blade
items.lore: A siog seeker's blade, cold to the touch even in the summer sun of Bri Leith.

items.name: Nymir's Hood
items.lore: Nymir watched the old ruined wall for a decade under this hood and was never once seen.

items.name: Riocard's Song-Harp
items.lore: Its strings were spun by the people of the mounds. It plays a little sweeter than the hand that plucks it.

items.name: Lusmorebane's Changeling Charm
items.lore: Lusmore the hunchback sang for the fairies and they took his hump. Lusmorebane hunted every changeling who sang that song after him.

items.name: Lashold's Hound-Hide Gloves
items.lore: Cut from the hide of the great hill hound of the south-west. They smell faintly of wet dog.

items.name: Hru's Empyrean Bulwark
items.lore: The empyrean guardian held the eastern glades with this shield for an age of men.

items.name: Niy's Overseer's Staff
items.lore: From the high glade by the well, Niy oversaw the empyreans of the north-east with this staff.

items.name: Gelbhan's Footpad Boots
items.lore: The siog chief who took the Coruscating Mine camp. These boots never made a sound on the mine road.

items.name: Fuamnach's Jealous Veil
items.lore: Fuamnach, first wife of Midir of Bri Leith, raised the wind that blew Etain across Erin for seven years. This veil is woven of that wind.

items.name: Girdle of the Sidhe Door
items.lore: Worn by the doorward of Midir's mound, who let no one into Bri Leith uninvited.

items.name: Midir's Rowan Spear
items.lore: Rowan wood from the hill of Bri Leith, tipped with a blade of the sidhe.

items.name: Etain's Scarlet Wing
items.lore: When Fuamnach's wind was beaten back, the scarlet fly left this behind on the menhir: a ring as bright as a wing in sunlight.

items.name: Druim Cain Ranger's Mantle
items.lore: Given by Captain Ronan to those who rode out with the rangers of Druim Cain and took back the herders' fold.
